notes: 'that was next to the king' is read as a recasting of the construct מִשְׁנֵה הַמֶּלֶךְ, with 'to' as the relational word carried by the rectum under rule 19.
בֶּן הַמֶּלֶךְ → 'the king's son' follows rule 29's possessive case: the 'the' at the left edge determines the possessor, so the article takes it and the construct keeps only 'son'.
